claims.subject: micro switch basic sensitive switch definition
claims.value: a basic sensitive switch is a self-contained snap-action microgap switch operated directly by a defined force through a defined travel

conditions.document_scope: snap-action sensitive switches and switch assemblies

claims.subject: micro switch snap action mechanism
claims.value: contact action in which the speed of the moving contacts is relatively independent of the speed of the actuating mechanism

claims.subject: basic sensitive micro switch
claims.value: uses snap action whose moving-contact speed is relatively independent of the actuating-mechanism speed

claims.subject: micro switch operating force actuating force
claims.value: the force or torque applied to the actuating mechanism to operate the contacts

claims.subject: micro switch release force releasing force
claims.value: the force or torque to which force on the actuator must be reduced to permit the contacts to return to the unoperated position after operation

claims.subject: micro switch pretravel
claims.value: the distance or angle through which the actuator moves from free position to operating position

claims.subject: micro switch overtravel
claims.value: the distance or angle between the operating position and the extreme position to which the actuator may be moved

claims.subject: micro switch movement differential differential travel
claims.value: the distance or angle through which the actuator travels from the operating position to the releasing position

claims.subject: micro switch differential travel movement differential
claims.value: the actuator distance or angle from operating position to releasing position

claims.subject: micro switch actuator travel pretravel overtravel
claims.value: pretravel runs from free position to operating position, while overtravel runs from operating position to the extreme permitted actuator position

claims.subject: micro switch force travel position terminology
claims.value: the specification distinguishes actuating force, releasing force, free position, operating position, movement differential, pretravel, and overtravel

claims.subject: micro switch device-specific travel limits
claims.value: numerical travel limits are requirements of the applicable specification sheet and must not be inferred from the component category

claims.subject: micro switch electrical ratings load voltage current
claims.value: rating values are specification-sheet requirements tied to stated load and test conditions, not universal switching capacities

claims.subject: micro switch AC DC electrical ratings
claims.value: use only the rating explicitly stated for the applicable current type, load, and test condition; a rating for one condition does not establish another

claims.subject: micro switch durability endurance electrical mechanical life
claims.value: a durability result applies only with its specified electrical load, operating sequence, cycle count, and environmental or test conditions

claims.subject: micro switch electrical life endurance cycle count
claims.value: a published electrical operation count must be read with the stated load, operating sequence, and test conditions

claims.subject: micro switch mechanical life endurance cycle count
claims.value: a published mechanical operation count must be read with the stated operating sequence and test conditions

claims.subject: micro switch contact resistance
claims.value: contact resistance is a measured switch requirement whose method, connection points, and limit must come from the applicable specification and test procedure

claims.subject: micro switch insulation resistance
claims.value: insulation resistance is evaluated between specified electrically isolated points using the applicable test method and conditions

conditions.document_scope: MIL-PRF-8805K insulation-resistance requirement and referenced test method

claims.subject: micro switch COM NO NC terminal symbols

conditions.scope: generic changeover terminology; verify the exact device schematic

claims.subject: micro switch COM NO NC transfer contact terminal
claims.value: a generic changeover contact may be labeled common, normally closed, and normally open, but the exact device marking or schematic controls

claims.subject: micro switch wiring diagram terminal identification ratings
claims.value: use the connection diagram, terminal marking, circuit function, and permissible load documented for the exact switch and equipment rather than a generic physical-layout inference

conditions.safety: follow applicable deenergization and qualification requirements

claims.subject: electrical safety micro switch wiring work
claims.value: the cited United States workplace rule generally requires exposed live parts to be deenergized before work, requires a qualified person to verify the deenergized condition with test equipment, and limits work on energized parts to qualified persons

conditions.jurisdiction: United States workplace rule; verify all applicable requirements

claims.subject: micro switch position movement limit detection application
claims.value: a miniature snap-action switch can change an electrical contact state in response to mechanical actuator movement and is commonly used for position or limit detection

conditions.scope: general background, not a suitability claim

claims.subject: IP Code enclosure protection
claims.value: classifies degrees of protection provided by enclosures under IEC 60529

claims.subject: IP Code characteristic numeral first second water solid

value.first_characteristic_numeral: protection against access to hazardous parts and ingress of solid foreign objects
value.second_characteristic_numeral: protection against harmful effects from ingress of water

claims.subject: IP rating application suitability limitation
claims.value: an IP code states defined enclosure-protection characteristics and does not by itself establish electrical rating, chemical compatibility, corrosion resistance, vibration endurance, condensation performance, or complete application suitability
